steps.title: Rocks survive terrain changes
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/rocks_survive.json at 1920x1080. New 150 ft alpine meadow and rocky badlands maps (seed 1234): a Tier stroke through the densest boulder field near the centre (captured before, still pressed, after, and close up), on alpine a Flatten stroke back over the new face, then a gentle Raise hill under another group of rocks. Rocks the stroke-end regeneration would remove become props (RockKeep), tilted with the ground up to 55 degrees and bedded on their tilted base so no part floats (GroundSnap.bed_under). The log's rocks.gd lines give floating props, tilt and twins. Nothing is saved.
